meta: Your first interview, your first tough customer, your first day teaching: many things you only learn by doing them for real, and mistakes cost you. Pilots and doctors practice in simulators. Now you can too, with AI.
prompt: Set up a 3-step scenario from my job as [your job]. At each step I choose what to do, and you tell me what happens.

muc.title: The first time is the real thing
muc.text: Your first interview, your first difficult customer, your first day teaching. Many things you only learn by doing them for real, and mistakes cost you.

muc.title: Pilots practice first
muc.text: Pilots and doctors don't learn that way. They practice in flight simulators and on mannequins, facing every bad situation without anyone getting hurt.

muc.title: Learning through simulation
muc.text: This is called simulation-based learning. You act, see the consequences right away, then try again until it feels natural.

muc.title: You decide, and know right away
muc.text: It works because you have to make the decisions yourself, and you find out right away if you were right. Ten pages of theory can't match handling it yourself once.

muc.title: Everyone gets a flight simulator
muc.text: Simulations used to be very expensive. Now with AI, everyone has their own flight simulator, right in the chat box.

muc.title: A 3-step scenario
muc.text: Ask AI to set up a three-step scenario from your job. At each step you make a decision, and AI tells you what happens. Mistakes are fine. Just play again from the start.

muc.title: Virtual labs
muc.text: Simulation isn't just for practicing conversations. Part two: doing experiments without a lab.
